answer_1.quote: We train DiffusionBERT on the One Billion Word dataset (LM1B) for unconditional generation. ... For conditional generation, we choose two tasks for evaluating DiffusionBERT, namely Question Generation (QG) and Paraphrasing.

answer_2.quote: We choose BLEU-4 and self-BLEU as the metric for generation quality and diversity, respectively. ... we also report Rouge-L for quality and Div-4 score for diversity.
